exch.label: Exchange
exch.description: Stock Exchange where a stock is listed.

idx.label: Index
idx.description: Major market Index that includes the stock.

sec.label: Sector
sec.description: Sector in which a company operates.

industry.label: Industry
industry.description: Industry in which a company operates.

geo.label: Country
geo.description: Country where the company is headquartered.

cap.label: Market Cap.
cap.description: Total market value of a company's outstanding shares (share price x shares outstanding).

fa_div.label: Dividend Yield
fa_div.description:
Annual dividend income as a percentage of the current stock price.

If there is no forward dividend estimate available, trailing twelve month (TTM) value is used.

sh_short.label: Short Float
sh_short.description: Percentage of publicly traded shares sold short.

an_recom.label: Analyst Recom.
an_recom.description: Consensus analyst rating on a stock.

sh_opt.label: Option/Short
sh_opt.description: Stocks with options and/or available to sell short.

earningsdate.label: Earnings Date
earningsdate.description: Date when company is expected to report earnings.

sh_avgvol.label: Average Volume
sh_avgvol.description: Average number of shares traded per day.

sh_relvol.label: Relative Volume
sh_relvol.description: Ratio of current volume compared to 3-month average, adjusted intraday.

ipodate.label: IPO Date
ipodate.description: Date the company first became publicly traded.

sh_outstanding.label: Shares Outstanding
sh_outstanding.description: Total number of shares issued and currently held by investors.

sh_float.label: Float
sh_float.description: The number of shares available for public trading. Doesn't include shares held by insiders.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Investing themes associated with the company.

subtheme.label: Sub-theme
subtheme.description: Investing sub-themes associated with the company.
